meta.hypothesis: Cartesian-d cc-pVDZ CCSD(T) on H₂O completes in ~1.5 minutes wall-clock in a browser tab, captures ~220 mHa of correlation energy, and matches PySCF spherical-d CCSD(T) within the expected Cartesian-vs-spherical d-shell slack (≤ 5 mHa).

diagnosis: Cartesian-d cc-pVDZ CCSD(T) for H₂O finishes in 106s wall ((T)-only 66s). Captures 221 mHa total correlation. Δ vs PySCF spherical-d CCSD(T) = -3.97 mHa (Cartesian-d basis is variationally larger; this slack matches literature reports of spherical-vs-Cartesian d for cc-pVDZ on water).
